tips.text: Run public on Steel Path; solo is slow because one player cannot defend and collect Remnants at once.
Bring Titania for the Remnants; Jade and Chroma work too.
Grab Remnants in the Void tunnel between halves, where they spawn thickest; hitting 50 there gives the crystal its overshield.
Bring crowd control like Nova slow, Khora or Vauban to keep the crystals safe, but do not kill so little that Remnants stop dropping.
Run for drops first and buy only the one or two pieces that refuse to drop, so you do not end up with duplicates.
Extract after Rotation B for Steflos alone; stay for C only for Citrine's parts, and past four rotations leave on a multiple of four.
Level weapons and frames during the grind so the time counts twice.
Players call Tyana Pass the slowest pity shop in the game; it is boring rather than hard.
Steflos alone is the easy part; parts and blueprints often drop several times over before Citrine finishes.
